comparisons.name: safari-light
comparisons.description: The tab bar of the key Safari window, Aqua: three tabs, the middle one selected, and the new-tab cell. Whole crop, titles included.

comparisons.name: safari-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As safari-light with the three titles masked (they are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms), to score the fills, the dividers, the bottom rows and the + glyph.

comparisons.name: safari-dark
comparisons.description: The tab bar of the key Safari window, Dark Aqua: three tabs, the middle one selected, and the new-tab cell. Whole crop, titles included.

comparisons.name: safari-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: As safari-dark with the three titles masked, to score the fills, the dividers, the bottom rows and the + glyph.

comparisons.name: inactive-light
comparisons.description: The tab bar of the inactive Safari window behind the Picture in Picture video, Aqua: two tabs, the second selected. Whole crop, titles included.

comparisons.name: inactive-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As inactive-light with the two titles masked, to score the flat fills, the divider and the bottom rows.

comparisons.name: inactive-dark
comparisons.description: The tab bar of the inactive Safari window behind the Picture in Picture video, Dark Aqua: two tabs, the second selected. Whole crop, titles included.

comparisons.name: inactive-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: As inactive-dark with the two titles masked.

comparisons.name: hover-light
comparisons.description: The pointer over a tab that is not selected, Aqua: its fill darkens; the selected tab is unchanged.

pixels.note: black at 7% over the measured tab fill at mid height (#bcbcbc); the darkening is inferred, no capture shows it
selected tab at mid height, measured (Light-Safari-v13 @ 1100,176)

comparisons.name: hover-dark
comparisons.description: The pointer over a tab that is not selected, Dark Aqua: its fill lightens.

pixels.note: white at 5% over the measured tab fill at mid height (#1d1e1f); inferred
selected tab at mid height, measured (Dark-Safari-v13 @ 1100,176)

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the selected tab, reached with Tab, Aqua: a ring inside the cell.

pixels.note: the focus ring colour (spec: focus-ring) at 50% over the selected fill #d1d1d1; that the ring is drawn inside the cell is inferred
selected fill inside the 3 pt ring

comparisons.name: focus-ring-dark
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the selected tab, reached with Tab, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: the dark focus ring colour at 50% over the selected fill #363638; inferred as above
selected fill inside the ring

comparisons.name: focus-inactive-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the selected tab in an inactive window, Aqua: no focus ring.

pixels.note: the selected tab of an inactive window, measured (Light-Safari-v13-Picture-in-Picture @ 1700,190), where the ring would be
the other tab of an inactive window, measured (@ 400,190)

comparisons.name: pressed-new-tab-light
comparisons.description: The new-tab button while the mouse is held down on it, Aqua: the + takes the selected title's colour.

pixels.note: horizontal stroke of the +: the measured selected-title colour; that a pressed + takes it is inferred
new-tab cell beside the glyph at mid height, measured (Light-Safari-v13 @ 2716,176)

comparisons.name: pressed-new-tab-dark
comparisons.description: The new-tab button while the mouse is held down on it, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: horizontal stroke of the +: the measured selected-title colour; inferred as above
new-tab cell beside the glyph at mid height, measured (Dark-Safari-v13 @ 2576,176)

comparisons.name: forced-colors-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours: the selected tab is the system's highlight colour, the other tab the canvas, and the divider between them survives as canvas text. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

pixels.note: selected tab: Highlight over Canvas; Chromium emulates Highlight as rgb(5 0 73) at 80%
the 1 pt divider: CanvasText
a tab that is not selected: Canvas
the bar's bottom border: CanvasText
horizontal stroke of the +: ButtonText, kept although it is drawn as a background
new-tab cell beside the +: Canvas

comparisons.name: forced-colors-close-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours, the pointer over a tab that is not selected: the cross of its close button, which is drawn as two backgrounds, keeps a system colour.

pixels.note: where the two strokes of the cross meet, 12 pt inside the tab (x 188) and from the top: ButtonText
inside the close button's square, beside the cross: Canvas

comparisons.name: forced-colors-close-selected-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours, the pointer over the selected tab: the cross takes the highlighted text's colour, over the highlight.

pixels.note: where the two strokes of the cross meet, 12 pt from the tab's edge and top: HighlightText
inside the close button's square, beside the cross: Highlight over Canvas, as in forced-colors-light

comparisons.name: toolbar-light
comparisons.description: The new-tab cell on its own at the trailing end of the toolbar of a Safari window with one tab, Aqua: its fill, the edge at its top and leading sides, the + and the two rows under the bar, with the toolbar's surface beside and above it. The last point of the width, which the window's own edge covers, is masked.

comparisons.name: toolbar-dark
comparisons.description: The new-tab cell on its own at the trailing end of the toolbar of a Safari window with one tab, Dark Aqua: its fill, the edge at its top and leading sides, the + and the two rows under the bar, with the toolbar's surface beside and above it. The last point of the width, which the window's own edge covers, is masked.
